title: MODE-RAG: Manifold Outlier Diagnosis and Energy-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation
title_zh: MODE-RAG：基于流形离群诊断与能量的检索增强生成评估
abstract_en: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) enhances Large Vision-Language Models, it remains highly susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations, causal fabrications, and sycophancy. Furthermore, existing mitigation pipelines often face an intervention paradox: static rules tend to unnecessarily disrupt accurate generations, whereas leaving the multi-modal reasoning completely unguided allows existing mismatches to cascade into severe logical fabrications. To quantify and mitigate these hallucinations, we propose a Multi-Agent system, MODE-RAG, driven by Variational Free Energy (VFE) and internal attention states to dynamically gate interventions. High-risk queries are routed to five stage-specific agents, integrating Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for rigorous causal derivation and logit perturbations to penalize sycophancy. Dedicated Correction and Overseer agents ensure formatting stability and perform post-hoc factual verification. To objectively evaluate our approach, we introduce ModeVent, a challenging subset derived from the MultiVent dataset. Extensive experiments indicate that our system effectively reduces hallucination rates and logical fabrication, significantly improving the robustness of M-RAG systems.
abstract_zh: 本文针对 Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation（M-RAG）在 Large Vision-Language Models 中容易产生跨模态幻觉、因果捏造与迎合性回答的问题，提出 Multi-Agent 系统 MODE-RAG。该方法利用 Variational Free Energy（VFE）与模型内部 attention states 动态判断是否需要干预：高风险查询会被路由到五个阶段化 agent，并结合 Monte Carlo Tree Search（MCTS）进行更严格的因果推导，同时通过 logit perturbation 抑制 sycophancy。系统还引入 Correction agent 与 Overseer agent，分别用于保证输出格式稳定性和进行事后事实核查。为评估方法效果，作者基于 MultiVent 构建了更具挑战性的 ModeVent 子集。实验表明，MODE-RAG 能显著降低幻觉率与逻辑捏造，提升 M-RAG 系统鲁棒性。
key_points_zh: 提出 MODE-RAG，一个由 Variational Free Energy 和内部 attention states 驱动的 Multi-Agent M-RAG 干预框架。
通过动态 gating 解决“干预悖论”：避免静态规则过度打断正确生成，同时防止无约束推理导致错误级联。
对高风险查询启用五阶段 agent，并结合 MCTS 做因果推导，使用 logit perturbation 惩罚迎合性回答。
引入 Correction 与 Overseer agents，分别负责格式稳定和事后事实验证，提高生成可靠性。
构建 ModeVent 评测子集；实验显示该方法可降低跨模态幻觉和逻辑捏造，增强 M-RAG 鲁棒性。

llm_assessment.comment: MODE-RAG adds multi-agent gating and verification for multimodal RAG hallucinations, but remains closer to a task pipeline than durable agent harness infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: MODE-RAG为多模态RAG幻觉加入多智能体门控与验证，但更像任务管线而非持久化智能体运行框架。
